Thanks Oliver — quick notes from the SE side:
- 200 RPS sustained at seq=512 is non-trivial but doable on the low-latency variant if batching and KV cache are tuned.
- Estimated tokens: 600k is plausible; to be safe we recommend a 25% buffer (so ~750k tokens) to cover retries and warm-up.
- We'll pin a compatible model variant to avoid fallback to higher-cost instances during the soak.

Ask to sales: we typically grant pilot headroom in two flavors — a short-lived promo credit (applied to the hosted account) or a dedicated short-term Dedicated node (rare). For this scope, promo credit is appropriate.

I'll include a short runbook for the soak (ramp schedule, success criteria, rollback).
